treeYaml:
type: question
label: Transit funding
text: How should Springfield fund expanded bus service?
support:
  - type: idea
    label: Sales tax
    text: Add a quarter-cent sales tax dedicated to transit.
    editorial_note: Needs revenue estimates.
    support:
      - type: claim
        label: Revenue
        text: A quarter-cent tax would raise about $9 million a year.
        sources:
          - https://example.org/budget-office/transit-revenue-estimate
  - type: idea
    label: Fare changes
    text: Raise fares during peak hours only.
